Name: The Exploitation Reference Data TRE (CSEXRB)
Description: The Exploitation Reference Data TRE (CSEXRB) provides exploitation support data, the acquisition, environment, performance, multi-mate/stereo, and the processing history parameters.

IMAGE_UUID.Name: UUID Assigned to the Current Image Plane
IMAGE_UUID.Description: This field contains the UUID assigned to the current image plane; the current image plane may consist of multiple image segments based on NITF file size restrictions.  In the multi-segment case, each instance of CSEXRB contained in an image segment which is part of the multi-segment image plane shall report the same UUID value in this field.

NUM_ASSOC_DES.Name: Number of GLAS/GFM DESs Associated with this image
NUM_ASSOC_DES.Description: This field shall contain the number of GLAS/GFM DESs associated with the current image.

ASSOC_DES_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_DES>.Name: Te UUID of the ith GLAS or GFM DES Associated with this Image
ASSOC_DES_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_DES>.Description: This field contains a UUID identifying the ith GLAS/GFM DES associated with the current image.

PLATFORM_ID.Name: Platform Identifier
PLATFORM_ID.Description: This field shall contain the platform identifier of the system that collected the current image.

PAYLOAD_ID.Name: Platform Identifier
PAYLOAD_ID.Description: This field contains the payload identifieer of the system that collected the current image.

SENSOR_ID.Name: Sensor Identifier
SENSOR_ID.Description: This field contains the sensor identifier of the system that collected the current image.

SENSOR_TYPE.Name: Sensor Type
SENSOR_TYPE.Description: This field contains a code identifying the type of sensor that collected the image.

GROUND_REF_POINT_X.Name: The X coordinate of the ground reference point
GROUND_REF_POINT_X.Description: The X coordinate of the ground reference points, which are in ECF coordinates.

GROUND_REF_POINT_Y.Name: The Y coordinate of the ground reference point
GROUND_REF_POINT_Y.Description: The Y coordinate of the ground reference points, which are in ECF coordinates.

GROUND_REF_POINT_Z.Name: The Z coordinate of the ground reference point
GROUND_REF_POINT_Z.Description: The Z coordinate of the ground reference points, which are in ECF coordinates.

DAY_FIRST_LINE_IMAGE.Name: Day of First Line of Synthetic Array Image
DAY_FIRST_LINE_IMAGE.Description: This field contains the date, in UTC, associated with the collection of the first line of the synthetic array image.

TIME_FIRST_LINE_IMAGE.Name: Image Duration Time
TIME_FIRST_LINE_IMAGE.Description: This field contains the number of seconds from midnight to the start of collection of the first line of the image and applies to the entire image even if the pixels span multiple image segments.

TIME_IMAGE_DURATION.Name: Image Duration Time
TIME_IMAGE_DURATION.Description: This field contains the signed time difference between the start collection times for the top and bottom lines of the image, i.e., time of bottom line minus time of top line. If the value is negative, then the image lines were chronologically collected from bottom to top, and this field represents the signed time difference between the chronological end of the top and bottom line collection. This field applies to the entire image even if the pixels span multiple image segments.

TIME_STAMP_LOC.Name: Location of Frame Time Stamps
TIME_STAMP_LOC.Description: This field identifies the TRE containing the frame time stamps.

REFERENCE_FRAME_NUM.Name: Reference Frame Number
REFERENCE_FRAME_NUM.Description: This field contains the absolute frame number of the first frame of this temporal block as determined by the collection system.

BASE_TIMESTAMP.Name: Base Time Stamp
BASE_TIMESTAMP.Description: This field contains the sensor identifier of the system that collected the current image.

DT_MULTIPLIER.Name: Delta Time Duration
DT_MULTIPLIER.Description: This field contains the number of nanoseconds equal to one 'time unit', or the minimum 'delta time' that can be expressed between frames.

DT_SIZE.Name: Byte Size of the Delta Time Values
DT_SIZE.Description: This field reports the size in bytes of the DTn values.

NUMBER_FRAMES.Name: Number of Frames in the Current Temporal Block
NUMBER_FRAMES.Description: This field reports the number of frames in this image segment for this camera and temporal block, i.e., the number of frames in the current frame sequence.

NUMBER_DT.Name: Number of Delta Time Values
NUMBER_DT.Description: This field represents the number of delta time unit (DTn) values contained in this NITF image segment.

DT<NUMBER_FRAMES>.Name: nth Delta Time Value
DT<NUMBER_FRAMES>.Description: This field records the nth delta time value.

MAX_GSD.Name: Maximum Mean Ground Sample Distance
MAX_GSD.Description: This field contains the predicted maximum mean GSD for the Primary Target (point targets) or center of image (area targets).

ALONG_SCAN_GSD.Name: Measured Along-Scan GSD
ALONG_SCAN_GSD.Description: This field contains the measured along-scan GSD for the Primary Target (point targets) or center of image (area targets).

CROSS_SCAN_GSD.Name: Measured Cross-Scan GSD
CROSS_SCAN_GSD.Description: This field contains the measured cross-scan GSD for the Primary Target (point targets) or center of image (area targets).

GEO_MEAN_GSD.Name: Measured Geometric Mean GSD
GEO_MEAN_GSD.Description: This field contains the measured geometric mean GSD for the Primary Target for the Primary Target (point targets) or center of image (area targets).

A_S_VERT_GSD.Name: Measured Along-Scan Vertical GSD
A_S_VERT_GSD.Description: This field contains the measured along-scan vertical GSD for the Primary Target (point targets) or center of image (area targets).

C_S_VERT_GSD.Name: Measured Cross-Scan Vertical GSD
C_S_VERT_GSD.Description: This field contains the measured cross-scan vertical GSD for the Primary Target (point targets) or center of image (area targets).

GEO_MEAN_VERT_GSD.Name: Measured Geometric Mean Vertical GSD
GEO_MEAN_VERT_GSD.Description: This field contains the measured geometric mean vertical GSD for the Primary Target (point targets) or center of image (area targets).

GSD_BETA_ANGLE.Name: Angle Between Along-Scan and Cross-Scan Directions
GSD_BETA_ANGLE.Description: This field provides the angle on the Earth-tangent plane between the along-scan and cross-scan directions at the Primary Target (point targets) or center of image (area targets).

DYNAMIC_RANGE.Name: Dynamic Range of Pixels in Image Across All Bands
DYNAMIC_RANGE.Description: This field reports the dynamic range of the pixels, 'digital numbers', in the image across all the bands collected by the sensor.

NUM_LINES.Name: Number of Lines in the Entire Image
NUM_LINES.Description: This field reports the number of lines in the entire image before image segmentation, if necessary.

NUM_SAMPLES.Name: Number of Samples Per Line in the Entire Image
NUM_SAMPLES.Description: This field reports the number of samples in the entire image before image segmentation, if necessary.

ANGLE_TO_NORTH.Name: Angle to True North
ANGLE_TO_NORTH.Description: This field contains the angle of the image segment with respect to True North, measured clockwise from the first row vector, i.e., a vector pointing from row, column 0,0 to 0, 'NCOLS minus 1' in the NITF CCS, to True North.

OBLIQUITY_ANGLE.Name: Obliquity Angle
OBLIQUITY_ANGLE.Description: This field contains the angle between the satellite vehicle (SV) nadir pointing vector and SV-to-target line-of-sight vector at TIME_FIRST_LINE_IMAGE.

AZ_OF_OBLIQUITY.Name: Azimuth of Obliquity
AZ_OF_OBLIQUITY.Description: This field contains the azimuthal angle of the SV-to-target line-of-sight vector projected in the target local horizontal plane, measured clockwise from True North computed at TIME_FIRST_LINE_IMAGE. The velocity control point of the focal plane is projected to the target local horizontal plane.

ATM_REFR_FLAG.Name: Atmospheric Refraction Flag
ATM_REFR_FLAG.Description: This field indicates whether a correction should be applied to the line-of-sight calculation to account for atmospheric refraction effects.

VEL_ABER_FLAG.Name: Velocity Aberration Flag
VEL_ABER_FLAG.Description: This field indicates whether a correction should be applied to the line-of-sight calculation to account for velocity aberration effects.

GRD_COVER.Name: Ground Cover Flag
GRD_COVER.Description: This field indicates whether the scene contains snow, or that the information is not available.

SNOW_DEPTH_CATEGORY.Name: Snow Depth Category
SNOW_DEPTH_CATEGORY.Description: This field provides the weighted average of the snow depths for all of the grids that overlap the tasked image area.

SUN_AZIMUTH.Name: Sun Azimuth Angle
SUN_AZIMUTH.Description: This field contains the sun azimuth angle at the predicted image collection start time, measured clockwise from True North in a plane tangent to the Earth's surface at the target location (as viewed from above the Earth's surface), of the line-of-sight vector from the target to the center of the Sun.

SUN_ELEVATION.Name: Sun Elevation Angle
SUN_ELEVATION.Description: This field contains the sun elevation angle in degrees from the local target plane to the sun, calculated at the predicted image collection start time where the local target plane is defined as a plane tangent to the Earth's surface at the target location.

PREDICTED_NIIRS.Name: NIIRS for the Mono Collection at Principal Target
PREDICTED_NIIRS.Description: This field contains the predicted NIIRS associated with the image. If the sensor is tasked by GSD, if NIIRS is not predicted.

CIRCL_ERR.Name: Circular Error
CIRCL_ERR.Description: This field contains the calculated mono CE90 value of the geolocation in the horizontal ground plane of the image based on the LE90 value. This value is specifically tied to the image product represented by this instance of the CSEXRB TRE.

LINEAR_ERR.Name: LINEAR Error
LINEAR_ERR.Description: This field contains the assumed mono LE90 value in feet perpendicular to the horizontal ground plane of the image. This value is specifically tied to the image product represented by this instance of the CSEXRB TRE.

CLOUD_COVER.Name: Cloud Cover
CLOUD_COVER.Description: This field reports the percentage of the image plance obscured by cloud.  A value of 999 indicates cloud cover is unknown.

ROLLING_SHUTTER_FLAG.Name: Rolling Shutter Flag
ROLLING_SHUTTER_FLAG.Description: This field indicates the type of integration across the image frame, with '0' indicating the same integration time is used across the image frame, and '1' indicating that the integration time changes across the image frame.

Values.0: same integration time across the frame
Values.1: changing time during integration across the frame

UE_TIME_FLAG.Name: Time Unmodeled Error Flag
UE_TIME_FLAG.Description: This field identifies whether time un-modeled error parameters are included.

RESERVED_LEN.Name: Length of Reserved Field
RESERVED_LEN.Description: This length of the reserved field should be '00000'.

RESERVED.Name: Reserved Field
RESERVED.Description: This field is reserved for future use.
